import sys
sys.path.insert(0,'submission')
from te.session import _controller_admit
for alpha in [1,1.5,1.875,1.999]:
 for rho in [1,8]:
  E=64; vals=[24000.0]*E;z=[0.0]*E;u=[0.0]*E;mxu=0;mxV=0;mxp=0
  for t in range(384):
   V=[alpha*vals[e]+(1-alpha)*z[e]+u[e] for e in range(E)]
   zz,tt,h=_controller_admit(V,list(range(E)),E,rho)
   un=[u[e]+alpha*vals[e]+(1-alpha)*z[e]-zz[e] for e in range(E)]
   z,u=zz,un
   mxu=max(mxu,max(u));mxV=max(mxV,max(V));mxp=max(mxp,max(tt))
  print('admit a',alpha,'rho',rho,'maxu',mxu,'maxV',mxV,'maxp',mxp)
PY
